notes: לבלתי סור: the complementizer that goes to the לְ, the not to בלתי as the negative morpheme standing in the clause (rule 48), and the supplied subject ye stays with the infinitive.
ספר תורת משה is a multi-level chain with no article morpheme in it, so both written the's are supplied — one on ספר and the second on תורת under rule 29.
ממנו fuses to therefrom under rules 22 and 30, headed on the preposition.
